_comment.drop_speed_min: centroid downward speed in frame-heights per second, measured over drop_window_s
_comment.drop_min: total centroid drop across the merged event, fraction of frame height
_comment.ar_*: box aspect ratio = height/width. tall >= ar_tall_min before, wide <= ar_wide_max after
_comment.low_hold_s: seconds the person must stay low after the drop ends; clips that end early use the available tail if >= min_post_s and allow_clip_end
_comment.low_*: a frame counts as low if ar <= low_ar_max OR cy >= post-drop cy - low_cy_margin
_comment.spark.offsets_s: frame times relative to drop end; 'mid' = midpoint of the drop
_comment.tracking: link detections / merge broken ids when boxes overlap (IoU or half of overlap-over-smaller-box) within max_gap_s
_comment.min_post_s: when the clip ends before low_hold_s, accept the tail if it is at least this long (dataset clips are trimmed right after impact)
